mapper.sql: p.pid,p.uid,p.wtitle,COALESCE(p.wdesc,'') AS wdesc,p.vurl, COALESCE(p.viewcount,0) AS viewcount,COALESCE(p.votecount,0) AS votecount,p.wstatus, DATE_FORMAT(p.cwtime,'%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s+08:00') AS cwtime, COALESCE(p.likep,0) AS likep,u.uname,u.avatar,p.pcid,c.pcname, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM liketable l WHERE l.targetid=p.pid AND l.targettype='帖子') AS realLikeCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM favorite f WHERE f.pid=p.pid) AS favoriteCount, (SELECT CASE WHEN a.act='reject' THEN a.reason ELSE NULL END FROM waudit a WHERE a.pid=p.pid ORDER BY a.ct DESC,a.aid DESC LIMIT 1) AS reason
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pwork p LEFT JOIN user u ON u.uid=p.uid
SELECT focal,aperture,shutter,iso,lens,camera FROM work_exif WHERE pid=#{pid}
